$comment: T-1573: the wake word's second stage. 'gate' rows: the house's /api/voice/speaker/verify reply (null: no reply, a non-verdict, the house down) and the adapter's /api/audio/wake-check answer; read by aura-adapter/tests/test_adapter.py. 'phone' rows: the route's HTTP status and body (status null: no answer within timeout_ms) and whether the phone opens the turn; read by WakeCheckTest.kt and android-app/tools/wake_check_test.py. 'line' rows: the decision line both print. A wake is dropped only when the gate itself would drop the voice (would_block); everything else opens, so a house that cannot say never costs the owner a wake.
